on Tuesday it plans to offer $400M of senior notes due 2033 in a private transaction.

The offering will comprise senior unsecured notes guaranteed by the company’s existing and future domestic subsidiaries that participate as borrowers or guarantors under the North American Credit Agreement.
The proceeds, combined with available cash, will be used to fund repayment of about $400M of outstanding borrowings under the North American revolving credit facility.
The notes will be offered to qualified institutional buyers and to certain investors outside the U.S.

title: PRA Group announces proposed $400M senior notes offering
